facts.fact: PS Belio Kipsang said KEMIS will be integrated with Civil Registration Services and the National Registration Bureau so each learner gets a UPI from birth under the Maisha ecosystem.

KEN.note: Document does not state the digital status of civil registration itself.

facts.fact: PS Julius Bitok said KEMIS, going live 9 January 2026, will integrate basic education, higher education and TVET with KNEC and TSC, with backend preparations under way with the Ministry of ICT and Konza Technopolis.
The Ministry of Education confirmed KEMIS will replace NEMIS and go live on 9 January 2026, holding records on learners, teachers and schools nationwide, with backend preparations under way.
PS Belio Kipsang said that under the Maisha ecosystem every newborn will be provided a UPI, also used by KEMIS, with the death certificate number as the UPI on death.

KEN.note: No statement on local civil registration offices entering events digitally.
Nothing on secondary school internet or digital curriculum.
KEMIS is a plan at its go-live date; no primary-school learner record entry is stated as in use.
